findings.summary: The site does not visibly honor the system dark theme.
findings.evidence: The dark screenshot is pixel-identical in size and appearance to the light screenshot; the dark probe reports color-scheme: normal and unchanged dark text/light surface styling.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and apply preference-driven light/dark design tokens using prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Reduced-motion support is not implemented for the observed animation.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no prefers-reduced-motion rule; under reduce, the slideUp animation still reports a 400 ms duration.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce override that removes non-essential transitions and auto-motion.

findings.summary: High-contrast preferences are not explicitly supported.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found neither prefers-contrast nor forced-colors handling, while Lighthouse also found 11 low-contrast elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast adaptations and avoid suppressing system colors for essential controls.

findings.summary: Reusable components rely on viewport rules rather than container-aware adaptation.
findings.evidence: Rendered stylesheet inspection found no @container or container-type signal across the homepage CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt container queries for cards and reused header/list modules, retaining a conventional fallback where needed.

findings.summary: Cold-load LCP is slow under Lighthouse conditions.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 7.9 s and FCP 3.1 s (performance 0.69), although the raw-CDP trace on a separate run measured LCP 1.50 s. The variance itself warrants field-data verification.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP resource, reduce render-blocking work, and validate with field Core Web Vitals.

findings.summary: Render-blocking and cache/image delivery opportunities delay content.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 1,070 ms render-blocking savings and 380 KiB image-delivery savings; HAR recorded 70 requests and 1.18 MB transferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline or split critical CSS, defer noncritical CSS/scripts, give the actual LCP image correct priority, and serve efficient image variants.

findings.summary: The homepage ships substantial unused CSS and JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 199 KiB unused CSS and 91 KiB unused JavaScript; third-party code includes a 95.5 KiB Forecast SDK.
findings.suggestedFix: Split page-specific bundles and conditionally load analytics, ad, and feature code only when needed.

findings.summary: Some content and controls lack accessible alternatives.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 4 images without alt text; Lighthouse found one untitled iframe, and the homepage search input had no associated label.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide meaningful alt text or explicit decorative alt, label the search field, and title every iframe.

findings.summary: Text and controls fail minimum color contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported 11 elements under the required contrast ratio.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet WCAG AA in every state and retest with forced-colors and axe/Lighthouse.

findings.summary: Heading structure is not consistently sequential.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse detected a skipped heading level. Focus probes were generally visible on rendered controls, so the issue is structural rather than a blanket focus failure.
findings.suggestedFix: Use headings to express a sequential document outline and preserve visible :focus-visible styles.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse errors-in-console found 7 entries; HAR also recorded aborted Amplitude and CMP requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove uncaught/runtime errors and handle optional third-party failures without console noise.

findings.summary: Several images omit intrinsic dimensions and all sampled images use legacy raster formats.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 4 images without width/height and 14 of 14 in JPG/PNG rather than AVIF/WebP.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic width/height and modern negotiated formats while retaining responsive srcset candidates.

findings.summary: At least one link is not crawlable.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse crawlable-anchors reported one failing link, while the page otherwise has viewport metadata and robots allows the public English routes.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a real href for navigation, reserving buttons for in-page actions.

findings.summary: The CSP permits unsafe script execution.
findings.evidence: Headers show HTTPS, HSTS and nosniff, but CSP script-src allows both unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval.
findings.suggestedFix: Move inline code to nonce/hash-authorized scripts, remove unsafe-eval, and tighten source allowlists.

findings.summary: The default page load has a broad tracking and third-party footprint.
findings.evidence: Tracker capture found 10 third-party origins including Rubicon and Amplitude; HAR attributes 23 requests and 447 KB to third parties. Several first-party analytics cookies last about 395 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Delay non-essential tracking until valid consent, reduce vendors and retention, and batch/minimize analytics.

findings.summary: Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy headers are absent.
findings.evidence: Header inspection found both headers missing; CSP frame policy, X-Frame-Options and HSTS are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Send a strict Referrer-Policy and least-privilege Permissions-Policy appropriate to the actual features.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes relative to displayed content.
findings.evidence: Image audit found an oversized lead image and no modern formats; Lighthouse estimated 380 KiB image-delivery savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP responsive candidates sized to layout slots and avoid downloading duplicate oversized hero variants.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts and fonts consume a disproportionate share of a text-news homepage.
findings.evidence: HAR measured 447 KB third-party transfer and 304 KB across 8 fonts, with tracking/ad services active on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party/font budget, subset fonts, and defer non-essential vendors until interaction or consent.
